tools.name: search
tools.description: Find theme parks, resorts, rides, shows, restaurants and hotels by name, and get their ids, park, resort and location. Call this first: every other tool needs an id from here. Small typos are forgiven. A name such as "Space Mountain" can match rides in several parks: each result names its park and r

tools.name: get_live_data
tools.description: What rides, shows and restaurants are doing right now: status (OPERATING, DOWN, CLOSED, REFURBISHMENT), standby and single-rider waits in minutes, return-time and boarding-group windows, paid queue prices, showtimes still running or to come (check `type`: "Special Ticketed Event" needs a separate ti

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Opening hours for a park or resort: today and the next 30 days, or one calendar month (past months show what was published then). Use for "what time does X open/close", "is X open today", "is X open right now" (compare with the current time in the park's timezone). Each row is a slot such as OPERATI

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: What something is: its name, type, ride type, timezone, location, which park and resort it belongs to, and attributes such as minimum height where the park publishes them (often it does not; say so rather than guess).

tools.name: get_daily_history
tools.description: One summary row per day: minutes operating, down and unknown (unconfirmed), first opening and last close (UTC), and standby wait statistics (min, median p50, mean, p90, max, in minutes). For a ride or show, ask a range of days; for a whole park, ask one `date` and get a row per ride. Use for "how bu

tools.name: show_wait_board
tools.description: Shows a park's live wait times as an interactive board the person can filter and refresh, with each ride's hourly forecast. Prefer this over `get_live_data` whenever the answer would be a list of several rides at one park: an overview, a ranking, a shortlist or a recommendation. It returns the same

tools.name: show_wait_history
tools.description: Shows one ride's or show's daily wait history as a chart: median and 90th-percentile standby waits, the longest wait, and time spent down, per day. Prefer this over `get_daily_history` for any request about one ride or show over a range of days, whatever the aspect: the waits, a trend, a pattern by

tools.name: refresh_wait_board
tools.description: Refreshes the wait board's data. Called by the board itself.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Signs the person in to their free ThemeParks.wiki account, which gives them their own rate limits instead of the limit shared by everyone using this app without an account. Use only when the person asks to sign in to ThemeParks.wiki. Signing in is optional: every other tool works without it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
